academic_year_covered: Mixed 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 - the sources are not aligned on one year. The governing teaching regulation is 'Regolamento in vigore a partire dall'a.a. 2025-2026' (published June 2025) and the orientamento.unina.it course profile is explicitly stamped 'The programme at a glance Updated 2025/2026', with the current study plan published as 'Study Plan a.a. 2025/2026 - ENG'. The DEADLINE data, by contrast, is already 2026/2027: unina.it published 'Immatricolarsi alla Federico II per l'a.a. 2026/2027' (news dated 08/07/26) with the 16 July - 2 November 2026 enrolment window, and international.unina.it publishes the 2026 non-EU pre-enrolment and visa deadlines. The ordinamento (RAD) on file was approved by the teaching structure on 04/02/2025 and by the Senate/Board on 24/02/2025. The legacy unina.it course sheet (/-/12778359) is materially STALE: it still lists the pre-reform study plan (Biomechanics, Systems and Synthetic Biology, Robotics for Bioengineering, Biomedical Imaging) that the 2025/2026 plan replaced.
program_name: Industrial Bioengineering. Internal University of Naples Federico II course code: DD3. Italian legal/administrative title used in parallel on unina.it and in the ordinamento: 'Bioingegneria Industriale' - the ordinamento sheet records 'Nome del corso in italiano: Bioingegneria Industriale' and 'Nome del corso in inglese: Industrial Bioengineering'. This is a STANDALONE English-taught Master of Science (Laurea Magistrale, 2nd cycle); it is NOT an English curriculum inside an Italian-named programme, and it is NOT the English track of another degree. The degree is awarded under the English name. MIUR/RAD course identifier: 1375576 ('modifica di: Bioingegneria Industriale (1375576)'). AlmaLaurea 'codicione': 0630107302200002. IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION: Federico II runs TWO distinct degree programmes in the same LM-21 R class. (1) This one - 'Industrial Bioengineering' / 'Bioingegneria Industriale', code DD3, taught in ENGLISH, administered by DICMaPI. (2) 'Ingegneria biomedica' / 'Biomedical Engineering', code D97, taught in ITALIAN, administered by DIETI (Dipartimento di Ingegneria Elettrica e delle Tecnologie dell'Informazione). Each ordinamento explicitly names the other under 'Corsi della medesima classe'. Do not conflate them: only DD3 is English-taught. The ordinamento justifies the two-programme split: Industrial Bioengineering 'si differenzia dal Corso di Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Biomedica ... per aspetti principalmente culturali e formativi', being built on industrial-engineering sectors - '68% dei CFU erogati ... appartengono ai settori ING-IND ed ICAR'. Programme lineage: consultation with local stakeholders dates from 18/09/2014 and the favourable opinion of the Regional Coordination Committee is dated 17/12/2015, i.e. the course was instituted for a.a. 2016/2017; AlmaLaurea transparency data covers 2016-2025.
teaching_language: English (100%). Multiple independent official statements agree. (1) The teaching regulation states 'Il corso e erogato integralmente in lingua inglese' (the course is delivered entirely in English). (2) The ordinamento/RAD field reads 'Lingua in cui si tiene il corso: inglese'. (3) The orientamento.unina.it course profile lists 'Language ENG' (single ENG marking). (4) The university International Course Catalogue lists it under '2-year Master's degrees (LM) > Engineering' as 'Industrial Bioengineering - ENG', with no IT/ENG dual marking (contrast with sibling DICMaPI programme 'Ingegneria Chimica / Chemical Engineering - IT/ENG', which IS dual). All teaching, exams and the final thesis discussion are in English; the regulation specifies the thesis is 'un manoscritto di circa 80-100 pagine' discussed before a committee. ITALIAN IS NOT REQUIRED: international.unina.it states that for a degree course in ENGLISH 'level B2 Italian language proficiency is not required'. There is NO Italian-language clause in this programme's regulation (unlike some other Federico II English-taught courses, e.g. Design for the Built Environment, which does impose an Italian check) - the only language requirement is English B2. Note the SSD codes in the 2025/2026 plan use the new post-reform coding (IBIO-01/A, ICHI-01/B, ICHI-01/C, CEAR-06/A, CEAR-07/A) rather than the legacy ING-IND/ICAR codes still cited in the ordinamento narrative.
campus: Naples (Napoli) - western sector of the city (Fuorigrotta / Agnano / Bagnoli), NOT the historic Corso Umberto I centre. TWO addresses matter and they are different. (1) TEACHING VENUE - the orientamento course profile states under 'Timetable': 'lessons are held in the building of via Nuova Agnano', with the lesson calendar on the EasyAcademy platform. Via Nuova Agnano is the third Engineering complex of Federico II, designed by architect Pasquale Manduca under a 1999 agreement with the Gruppo Giustino and in use since 2001; unina.it describes it as sited 'in un'area di limite tra Fuorigrotta, Agnano e il versante orientale di Bagnoli'. It contains classrooms, laboratories, a library and studios (~30,000 cubic metres). The international.unina.it course entry lists both 'PIAZZALE TECCHIO - POLO OVEST "FUORIGROTTA"' and 'VIA NUOVA AGNANO' for this programme. Transport to Via Nuova Agnano per DICMaPI: Metro Line 2 Cavalleggeri or Bagnoli stations (both ~10 min on foot), or Cumana Agnano station; by car Tangenziale exit Agnano; ANM buses from Piazzale Tecchio (M1B towards Pozzuoli, C2 towards Via Piscarelli, C1 along via Diocleziano) or ~20 min on foot along Via Diocleziano. [uncertain] The STREET NUMBER of the Via Nuova Agnano complex is not stated on any of the official unina.it pages consulted - they give only the street name - so the exact postal address of the teaching building could not be verified. (2) DEPARTMENT / ADMINISTRATIVE SEAT - Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica, dei Materiali e della Produzione Industriale (DICMaPI), Piazzale V. Tecchio 80, 80125 Napoli. The orientamento 'Directions' block gives this address with connections: Metro Line 2 Campi Flegrei station, Metro Line 6 Mostra station, Cumana Mostra station. School: Scuola Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base (SPSB) - orientamento lists 'Faculty Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base'. The programme sits within the Collegio di Ingegneria of SPSB. Student Administration Office (Segreteria Studenti) contact: Flavio Ciccarelli, tel. 081-7682208, segreing@unina.it.
degree_class: LM-21 R - Ingegneria biomedica (Biomedical Engineering). The reformed class code 'LM-21 R' is what the current governing documents use: the teaching regulation heads the document 'REGOLAMENTO DIDATTICO DEL CORSO DI STUDIO INDUSTRIAL BIOENGINEERING / LM-21 R', and the ordinamento sheet reads 'Classe LM-21 R - Ingegneria biomedica'. The 'R' suffix denotes the reformed (riformata) degree class. Older and secondary pages - including the orientamento course profile ('Degree class LM-21') and AlmaLaurea - write it simply as 'LM-21'; both forms refer to the same Italian degree class for Biomedical Engineering. Duration: 2 years (regulation Art. 9: 'La durata legale del Corso di Studio e di 2 anni'), 120 CFU/ECTS, delivered over 4 semesters. Credit types used (TAF): B) caratterizzanti, C) affini o integrative, D) a scelta dello studente, E) prova finale, F) ulteriori attivita formative. The degree is obtained with no more than 12 exams including the final exam ('con il superamento degli esami, in numero non superiore a 12 ivi compreso l'esame finale'). Total-CFU range declared in the RAD: 'CFU totali per il conseguimento del titolo 120', 'Range CFU totali del corso 90 - 156'. Maximum credits recognisable from prior study: 24 CFU ('Massimo numero di crediti riconoscibili 24 - max 24 CFU, da DM 931 del 4 luglio 2024'). Course delivery mode: 'Corso di studio convenzionale' (conventional, in-person; not distance learning). Attendance is NOT compulsory: regulation Art. 10 - 'la frequenza alle lezioni frontali e fortemente consigliata ma non obbligatoria'.
admission_type: OPEN ACCESS (accesso libero / non a numero programmato) subject to a MANDATORY two-part entry check - curricular requirements plus verification of personal preparation. There is no selection call, no ranking, no numero programmato and no entrance examination. Evidence: (a) the orientamento.unina.it course profile's structured 'Admission' field reads 'Verifica di preparazione' (verification of preparation), not 'numero programmato'; (b) the teaching regulation Art. 5 leaves any capping to the CCD as a mere possibility that has not been exercised - 'La Commissione di Coordinamento Didattico del corso di norma disciplina i criteri di ammissione e l'eventuale programmazione delle iscrizioni' - and the only footnote on programmed access refers to NATIONAL programming under Law 264/1999, which does not apply to this class; (c) unina.it's 2026/2027 enrolment notice routes first-year enrolment for accesso libero courses straight through the Segrepass online portal ('Questa modalita d'iscrizioni al primo anno puo essere utilizzata solo per immatricolarsi ai corsi ad accesso libero'), explicitly contrasting this with 'lauree a numero programmato' which follow separate bandi. LAYERS THAT APPLY IN PRACTICE: (1) curricular requirements check - the applicant must hold an L-8 or L-9 first-cycle degree, or a foreign degree recognised as suitable; (2) verification of the adequacy of personal preparation, which is COMPULSORY in every case and open only to candidates who already meet the curricular requirements ('La verifica della personale preparazione e obbligatoria in ogni caso, e possono accedervi solo gli studenti in possesso dei requisiti curriculari') - but which is WAIVED by a weighted average of at least 24/30; (3) English B2 verification; (4) for candidates with a FOREIGN degree, a case-by-case dossier assessment by the CCD / Commissione Pratiche Studenti e Valutazione Carriere, with a discretionary interview. The Commission's judgement in the sub-24/30 route is final ('valutera con giudizio insindacabile l'ammissibilita della richiesta'). NOTE that the profile of applicant determines the channel: Italian graduates enrol directly through Segrepass; EU graduates with a foreign qualification must enrol IN PERSON after the Coordinator has assessed their documents; non-EU applicants resident abroad must go through Universitaly pre-enrolment first.
academic_requirements: 1) FIRST-CYCLE DEGREE IN A SPECIFIED CLASS. The regulation Art. 4 states: 'Per essere ammessi al CdS Magistrale in Industrial Bioengineering occorre essere in possesso del titolo di Laurea appartenente alla classe L-8 o L-9 ai sensi del D.M. 270/04, rispettando i requisiti minimi curriculari specificati nel regolamento didattico del CdS, o altro titolo acquisito all'estero e riconosciuto idoneo.' L-8 = Ingegneria dell'informazione (Information Engineering); L-9 = Ingegneria industriale (Industrial Engineering). Holders of an L-8 or L-9 degree 'possono accedere direttamente al corso'. Enrolment is NOT permitted where the minimum curricular requirements are unmet ('L'iscrizione al Corso non e consentita in difetto dei requisiti minimi curriculari qui specificati'). 2) AUTOMATIC SATISFACTION FOR CERTAIN FEDERICO II GRADUATES. Per the programme's own admission page: 'students with a degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering or Biomedical Engineering (L-9) at the University of Naples Federico II automatically satisfy the curricular requirements'. 3) MINIMUM GRADE AVERAGE 24/30. Applicants whose CFU-weighted average of first-degree exam marks is at least 24/30 are EXEMPT from the personal-preparation check: 'Sono esonerati da tale verifica gli studenti per i quali la media delle votazioni (in trentesimi) ... pesate sulla base delle relative consistenze in CFU - sia non inferiore a 24.' Applicants BELOW 24/30 are not automatically rejected: their request goes to the CCD (which may call on the Commissione Pratiche Studenti e Valutazione Carriere), which decides with a final, unappealable judgement, may weigh the marks obtained in characterising or otherwise particularly relevant courses, and may set interviews or tests ('colloqui, test') to check personal preparation. 4) CURRICULAR INTEGRATIONS IF REQUIREMENTS ARE PARTLY UNMET. The CCD recognises the candidate's credits in whole or in part and prescribes one of three routes (regulation Art. 5.3): (a) integrations completed BEFORE enrolment, by registering for single courses activated by the University and passing the relevant exams (art. 6 c.1 D.M. 16 March 2007; art. 16 c.6 RDA); (b) enrolment in a bachelor's course giving automatic access, with an abbreviated path and a study plan carrying the needed integrations; (c) enrolment in the master's itself with a study plan containing alignment paths, 'senza aggravio di CFU' (without additional credit burden), per art. 6 c.3 D.M. 16 March 2007. 5) FOREIGN QUALIFICATIONS - CASE-BY-CASE. 'Le richieste di iscrizione da parte di studenti che hanno conseguito titolo all'estero sono valutate caso per caso dalla suddetta Commissione, che analizza nel dettaglio il transcript of records, o documenti equivalente, il syllabus o course contents e le certificazioni di conoscenza della lingua inglese.' Minimum grade for foreign applicants: 'CGPA non inferiore a 8.00/10.00 (min pass 6.00/10.00)'. Eligible foreign backgrounds per the REGULATION (authoritative): Ingegneria Biomedica, Ingegneria Chimica, Ingegneria dei Materiali (Biomedical, Chemical, Materials Engineering). The Italian-language admission WEBPAGE lists a WIDER set - 'Ingegneria Biomedica, Ingegneria dei Materiali, Ingegneria Chimica, Ingegneria Meccanica ed Ingegneria Elettronica' (adding Mechanical and Electronic Engineering) - while the English-language version of the SAME page lists only three (Biomedical, Materials, Chemical). See uncertainty_notes. 6) HIGH-ACHIEVING NON-STANDARD BACKGROUNDS. The regulation leaves a deliberate door open: 'Al fine di consentire l'accesso anche a laureati/e con elevata preparazione, provenienti da percorsi formativi non perfettamente coerenti con i requisiti richiesti, si puo prevedere per tali laureati/e un diverso percorso di ingresso e/o specifiche prove di ammissione.' 7) ENGLISH B2 - see language_requirements. 8) Maximum 24 CFU may be recognised from prior careers (DM 931 of 4 July 2024).
entry_exam_or_test: NO competitive entrance examination, NO TOLC, NO GRE/GMAT, NO portfolio. This is not a selection-by-ranking programme. What DOES exist are three conditional assessment mechanisms: (1) VERIFICA DELLA PERSONALE PREPARAZIONE (verification of personal preparation) - formally compulsory for every candidate ('obbligatoria in ogni caso') under art. 6 c.2 DM 270/04, but AUTOMATICALLY SATISFIED, with no test to sit, by anyone whose CFU-weighted first-degree average is at least 24/30. Only candidates below that threshold face an actual assessment, and even then the CCD may decide on documents alone; the regulation permits but does not mandate 'modalita di accertamento (colloqui, test)' - interviews or tests. (2) INTERVIEW FOR FOREIGN-DEGREE APPLICANTS - discretionary, not routine: 'La Commissione si avvale della facolta di intervistare il/la candidato/a in casi specifici per valutare la personale preparazione' (the Commission reserves the right to interview the candidate in specific cases). Foreign applicants are also asked to complete an online application form referenced on the programme's SignUP page - 'Students are invited to fill out the online form and carefully follow the instructions provided' - though [uncertain] on the live page that phrase is styled as a link label but carries no working hyperlink, so the form's URL could not be captured; applicants are told to contact bioenginering@unina.it. (3) ENGLISH PLACEMENT TEST (CLA) - this is the mechanism for candidates WITHOUT an English certificate. The Centro Linguistico di Ateneo (CLA) runs an online English placement test for first-year students of the Collegio di Ingegneria master's programmes, and Industrial Bioengineering is EXPLICITLY among the listed programmes. The test is 'svolto interamente online' and exists 'per accertare le competenze linguistiche richieste dal Regolamento Didattico'; the required level is B2 (B1 only for Building Engineering). Students already holding a recognised certificate obtained within the previous two years submit it to the course coordinator instead of sitting the test. Students who do not pass are offered a 30-hour remedial course delivered by the CLA. [uncertain] The published placement-test calendars found are historical (test sessions 4-12 May 2021 via DICEA; a session on 18 April 2023 at the CLA premises, via Mezzocannone 8, 4th floor, with registration at esol.unina.it) - the CURRENT 2026/2027 test dates are not published on the pages consulted and are said to be 'comunicato periodicamente dal Centro Linguistico di Ateneo (CLA)' at www.cla.unina.it. NOTE also that this placement test is a POST-ENROLMENT curricular check on first-year students, not a pre-admission screening exam.
seats_total: No seat cap is published, and none appears to exist: the programme is open access (accesso libero), so there is no numero programmato, no ranking and no bando fixing a number of places. The teaching regulation mentions programmed enrolment only as an unexercised power of the CCD ('l'eventuale programmazione delle iscrizioni') and, in a footnote, only in relation to NATIONAL programmed access under Law 264/1999, which does not cover the LM-21 class. Neither the ordinamento/RAD, nor the orientamento.unina.it course profile, nor the DICMaPI programme site states a number of places or a sustainable-enrolment ('utenza sostenibile') figure for this course. [uncertain] Whether an internal sustainable-enrolment figure exists in the non-public SUA-CdS quadros could not be verified, because the current corsi.unina.it/DD3 catalogue sheet is a JavaScript-rendered single-page application whose data API was not reachable without a browser.
non_eu_reserved_seats: [uncertain] No reserved non-EU quota (contingente riservato) is published for this programme on any unina.it source consulted. Reserved-place quotas at Federico II are published in the bandi of NUMERO PROGRAMMATO courses (for example the single-cycle Architecture call publishes 93 places of which 3 are reserved for non-EU citizens residing abroad, 1 of them for Chinese citizens); because Industrial Bioengineering is open access, no such call and therefore no such quota was found. international.unina.it sets a procedural deadline for non-EU pre-enrolment but no numeric quota for this course. Applicants should assume no fixed non-EU quota but verify the annual MUR contingente for Federico II on Universitaly, which was not retrievable per-programme from the official pages consulted.
language_requirements: ENGLISH B2 (CEFR) IS MANDATORY AND IS THE ONLY LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT. The ordinamento's access clause states: 'Per l'accesso al corso si richiede inoltre la documentata capacita di utilizzare correttamente, in forma scritta e orale, la lingua inglese, almeno pari al livello B2 (CEFR), secondo i criteri definiti nel regolamento didattico' - i.e. DOCUMENTED ability to use English correctly in BOTH written and oral form, at not less than B2. The teaching regulation reinforces this as a certificate requirement: 'E inoltre necessario il possesso di una certificazione di conoscenza della lingua inglese di livello non inferiore a B2 (secondo la scala definita dal CEFR o valutazioni equivalenti)' - note the escape clause 'o valutazioni equivalenti' (or equivalent assessments), which is what allows the CLA placement test to substitute for a commercial certificate. The programme's admission page repeats it in English: 'a knowledge of the English language of at least B2 level (according to the CEFR scale) is required'; for foreign applicants it is stated as a hard document requirement - 'Students must have a CGPA of at least 8.00/10.00 (min pass 6.00) and a suitable English certificate'. ACCEPTED CERTIFICATES: the Italian-language admission page links the phrase 'idoneo certificato di inglese' to the Ministry of Education's official register of accredited certifying bodies (piattaformaenticert.pubblica.istruzione.it), and the CLA publishes the list of recognised bodies at www.cla.unina.it; international.unina.it names 'IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge, etc.' as the usual international certificates. A certificate is accepted if obtained within the previous two years for placement-test exemption purposes. ALTERNATIVE ROUTE: candidates without a certificate sit the CLA online English placement test for Collegio di Ingegneria master's students (Industrial Bioengineering is on the list of covered programmes); non-passers take a 30-hour CLA course. ITALIAN IS NOT REQUIRED: international.unina.it states plainly that for a degree course in ENGLISH, 'level B2 Italian language proficiency is not required'; the B2 Italian certification requirement applies only to Italian-taught courses. There is NO Italian-language clause anywhere in this programme's regulation or ordinamento. Practical caveat from international.unina.it: an English certificate is nonetheless 'useful for the issue of the visa by the diplomatic/consular Representation', so non-EU applicants should obtain one even though the placement-test route exists. Note the mismatch of thresholds by applicant type: Italian/EU applicants are measured on a 24/30 weighted average, foreign-degree applicants on a CGPA of 8.00/10.00.
application_deadline_eu: TWO DISTINCT STEPS, ONLY ONE OF WHICH HAS A PUBLISHED CALENDAR DATE. (1) ENROLMENT (immatricolazione) FOR a.a. 2026/2027 - 16 JULY 2026 to 2 NOVEMBER 2026. unina.it's official notice (dated 08/07/26) reads: 'Dal 16 luglio e fino al 2 novembre, attraverso il servizio di segreteria studenti on-line "Segrepass", e possibile iscriversi al primo anno di un corso ad accesso libero' and 'Anche quest'anno e possibile procedere all'immatricolazione a partire dal 16 luglio e fino al 2 novembre 2026.' Enrolment is exclusively online via www.segrepass.unina.it and this route applies precisely because Industrial Bioengineering is an accesso libero course. Normalised ISO: 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-02. (2) ACADEMIC ASSESSMENT OF A FOREIGN QUALIFICATION - NO PUBLISHED DEADLINE. [uncertain] EU candidates (and non-EU candidates already legally resident in Italy or an EU country, who are treated as EU) holding a foreign degree must FIRST have their qualification assessed, and international.unina.it instructs them to 'send your academic documents to the Coordinator of the course you wish to enrol in to find out whether you meet the enrolment requirements'. Neither international.unina.it nor the DICMaPI programme pages publish a cut-off date for this step; in practice it must be completed early enough to enrol before 2 November 2026. EU candidates with a foreign qualification 'devono immatricolarsi in presenza' (must enrol IN PERSON), unlike Italian-qualification holders who complete everything online. unina.it further notes 'Gli studenti stranieri per immatricolarsi devono invece contattare via mail le segreterie studenti' (foreign students must contact the student offices by email to enrol). (3) YEARS AFTER THE FIRST - enrolment opens 1 September; the orientamento profile states 'Registrations and enrollments for years following the first usually take place in the period 1st September - 31st December of each year' (2026-09-01 to 2026-12-31). (4) SECOND-SEMESTER ENTRY - not documented for this programme; nothing in the regulation provides for a second intake, in contrast with some other Federico II master's courses.
application_deadline_non_eu: FOR NON-EU CANDIDATES RESIDING ABROAD (visa-requiring), the binding dates are set centrally by international.unina.it, not by the programme. (1) 15 JUNE 2026 - UNIVERSITALY PRE-ENROLMENT DEADLINE. Verbatim: 'JUNE - 15 - 2026 - Pre-enrolment application deadline to University of Naples Federico II. After this date no programme changes are permitted. After this date pre-enrolment is allowed to the programmes with restricted access only.' Normalised ISO: 2026-06-15. This is the operative deadline for Industrial Bioengineering, and it is EARLY relative to the EU enrolment window - critically, because this programme is OPEN access rather than restricted access, the concession allowing late pre-enrolment after 15 June applies only to 'programmes with restricted access', so a non-EU applicant who misses 15 June appears to lose the year for this course. (2) 30 NOVEMBER 2026 - VISA APPLICATION DEADLINE. Verbatim: 'NOVEMBER - 30 - 2026 - Deadline for submitting the Visa Application at Iyalian [sic - typo in the original for "Italian"] Embassies /Consulates.' Normalised ISO: 2026-11-30. (3) PROCESS ORDER: pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal (www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri) naming University of Naples Federico II, this degree programme and the chosen Embassy/Consulate -> university validates the pre-enrolment -> Embassy issues a type 'D' study visa ('studio-immatricolazione universita') -> enrolment at the university. international.unina.it warns 'pre-enrolment alone does not grant admission to degree programmes' and that admission still depends on passing the entry-requirement verification. (4) NON-EU CANDIDATES WHO DO NOT NEED A VISA (legally resident in Italy or an EU country) are treated like EU candidates: they skip Universitaly entirely ('You will therefore not need to pre-register on the Universitaly Portal') and present documents directly to the Course Coordinator, then follow the 16 July - 2 November 2026 enrolment window. (5) [uncertain] The programme itself publishes NO departmental deadline: the DICMaPI SignUP page describes a rolling, case-by-case evaluation ('Requests from students who have obtained their degree abroad ... are evaluated on a case-by-case basis') with no date, and the online application form it references is not reachable. Applicants should treat 15 June 2026 as the hard date and contact bioenginering@unina.it months in advance.
required_documents: A) FOR ACADEMIC ASSESSMENT BY THE COURSE COMMISSION (all foreign-degree applicants). Per the teaching regulation, the Commission examines in detail: the TRANSCRIPT OF RECORDS or equivalent document; the SYLLABUS / COURSE CONTENTS of the completed degree; and the ENGLISH LANGUAGE CERTIFICATION. In practice also: proof of the CGPA (minimum 8.00/10.00, min pass 6.00) and the completed online application form referenced on the SignUP page. Contact: bioenginering@unina.it. B) FOR EU CANDIDATES (and non-EU candidates resident in Italy/EU) - the enrolment dossier, identical on the DICMaPI page and international.unina.it: (1) DIPLOMA SUPPLEMENT; (2) CERTIFICATES FROM THE ITALIAN ENIC-NARIC CENTRE (CIMEA) - www.cimea.it; (3) EXAM HISTORY / certificates of examinations ('Storico esami'); (4) any DECLARATIONS OF VALUE (Dichiarazione di Valore) issued by the competent diplomatic representations, LEGALISATIONS or TRANSLATIONS. These students must enrol IN PERSON. C) FOR NON-EU CANDIDATES RESIDING ABROAD - documents to bring to the Italian Embassy: (1) the SUMMARY OF THE PRE-ENROLMENT APPLICATION submitted through Universitaly and validated by the University of Naples Federico II; (2) any LANGUAGE COMPETENCE CERTIFICATES; (3) the documents required for the VISA APPLICATION, including a HEALTH INSURANCE POLICY where applicable; (4) the required documents for the FOREIGN QUALIFICATION. Documents to obtain FROM the Embassy: the type 'D' study entry visa, the stamped health insurance policy, and the endorsed foreign-qualification documents. D) FOR FINAL ENROLMENT AT THE UNIVERSITY (non-EU): copy of PASSPORT, the APPLICATION FORM, a PASSPORT PHOTO, the Italian TAX CODE (codice fiscale), proof of RESIDENCE PERMIT, and the declaration of validity of the qualification issued by the Italian Embassy or an ENIC-NARIC centre. E) VISA-RELATED FINANCIAL EVIDENCE (non-EU): proof of means of subsistence quantified at EUR 10,179.85 per year, repatriation funds (return ticket or equivalent), evidence of suitable accommodation, and valid medical/hospitalisation insurance. For the residence permit (stays over 90 days, to be applied for within 8 working days of arrival) the stated minimum annual funds are EUR 6,079.45 (about EUR 467.95 monthly); renewal requires an enrolment certificate and proof of having passed at least one exam in the first year and two per year thereafter. F) FOR ITALIAN-QUALIFICATION HOLDERS: no document dossier - enrolment is fully online through Segrepass, guided by the 'Guida all'immatricolazione online' at segrepass.unina.it. G) OPTIONAL BUT USEFUL: a PRE-ACCEPTANCE LETTER, which the programme says it will issue on request to support a student visa application ('In the event of a positive outcome and upon request, students may receive a pre-acceptance letter to support their student visa application') - but see uncertainty_notes, as international.unina.it states the opposite at university level.
tuition_or_fees_link: PRIMARY LINKS: (1) University student guides and enrolment/fee guide - https://www.unina.it/didattica/sportello-studenti/guide-dello-studente (redirects to https://www.old.unina.it/didattica/sportello-studenti/guide-dello-studente); (2) Official fee CALCULATOR - http://calcolatrice.unina.it/; (3) Programme fee summary (English) - https://www.dicmapi.unina.it/ug_bioenginering/signup/?lang=en and (Italian) https://www.dicmapi.unina.it/ug_bioenginering/iscriversi/; (4) University-level statement for international students - https://www.international.unina.it/education/admission-regulation/; (5) 'Quick guide to paying taxes' PDF as linked by the programme - https://www.unina.it/documents/11958/35974352/Guida_Studente_rapida_23-24.pdf. SUMMARY OF AMOUNTS (stated identically on the programme page, the unina.it course sheet and international.unina.it): EU STUDENTS - EUR 200/year university tuition contribution + EUR 140/year regional tax + EUR 16.00 revenue stamp (marca da bollo), i.e. about EUR 356/year all-in. NON-EU STUDENTS - exempt from the tuition contribution, paying only EUR 140/year regional tax + EUR 16.00 stamp, i.e. about EUR 156/year; verbatim Italian: 'Gli studenti extracomunitari sono esentati dal pagamento dell'iscrizione ma devono pagare 140 EUR/anno di tasse regionali' and verbatim English: 'Non-EU students are exempt from paying the tuition fee but must pay EUR 140/year in regional taxes and a EUR 16 stamp duty'. FOR ITALIAN STUDENTS the contribution is NOT flat: 'Il contributo per l'iscrizione viene determinato in funzione del reddito (ISEE Universitario) e della carriera (numero di cfu conseguiti e anno di iscrizione) di ciascuno studente' - i.e. means-tested on the university ISEE and on academic progress. FUNDING signposted by the programme: 'Study in Naples' grants for EU and non-EU citizens; Italian government grants for foreign citizens and Italians resident abroad (Italian Development Cooperation Agency); COINOR; and ADISU-RC (Azienda per il Diritto allo Studio Universitario della Regione Campania), which also administers the regional right-to-study benefits. Student services signposted: International Welcome Desk (IWD) and SINAPSI (supporto.sinapsi@unina.it) for students with disabilities/SLD. See uncertainty_notes on the age of the linked fee guide.

official_call_url: NO call/bando exists for this programme - it is open access, so admission is governed by regulation rather than by an annual competitive call. The GOVERNING OFFICIAL DOCUMENTS are: (1) TEACHING REGULATION (Regolamento Didattico del CdS), in force from a.a. 2025-2026, 39 pages - https://www.dicmapi.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Regolamento-Didattico-Industrial-Bioengineering-LM-21_2025.pdf ; (2) ORDINAMENTO / RAD sheet for LM-21 R Industrial Bioengineering (course code DD3), approved by the teaching structure 04/02/2025 and by the Senate/Board 24/02/2025 - https://www.unina.it/documents/11958/86089091/LM_21_R_IndBio.pdf , listed on the university's ordinamenti index at https://www.unina.it/ateneo/statuto-e-normativa/regolamenti/regolamenti-didattici/ordinamenti-cds as 'LM21 R - Industrial Bioengineering'; (3) UNIVERSITY-WIDE ENROLMENT NOTICE for a.a. 2026/2027 - https://www.unina.it/it/w/immatricolarsi-alla-federico-ii-copia-1- (also at https://www.orientamento.unina.it/immatricolarsi-alla-federico-ii-per-la-a-2026-2027/); (4) INTERNATIONAL ADMISSION RULES with the non-EU deadlines - https://www.international.unina.it/education/admission-regulation/ ; (5) SPSB admission-to-courses page - http://www.scuolapsb.unina.it/index.php/studiare-al-napoli/ammissione-ai-corsi ; (6) current study plan - 'Study Plan a.a. 2025/2026 - ENG' linked from the orientamento profile. For contrast, the sibling ITALIAN-taught LM-21 R programme's ordinamento (code D97, DIETI) is at https://www.unina.it/documents/11958/86089091/LM21_R_IngBio.pdf - do NOT cite that document for this programme.
source_quotes: LANGUAGE / IDENTITY: 'Il Corso di Studio in Industrial Bioengineering afferisce al Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica, dei Materiali e della Produzione Industriale. Il corso e erogato integralmente in lingua inglese. La modalita di svolgimento e convenzionale.' (Regolamento Didattico, Art. 1). 'Nome del corso in italiano Bioingegneria Industriale ... Nome del corso in inglese Industrial Bioengineering ... Lingua in cui si tiene il corso inglese ... Codice interno all'ateneo del corso DD3' (ordinamento LM_21_R_IndBio.pdf). 'Corsi della medesima classe Ingegneria biomedica' (ordinamento, DD3) and reciprocally 'Corsi della medesima classe Industrial Bioengineering' (ordinamento LM21_R_IngBio.pdf, code D97, 'Lingua in cui si tiene il corso italiano'). STRUCTURED PROFILE FIELDS: 'Degree class LM-21 | Degree required Laurea I Livello | Admission Verifica di preparazione | Language ENG | Faculty Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base | Department Ingegneria Chimica, dei Materiali e della Produzione Industriale' (orientamento.unina.it). 'The programme at a glance Updated 2025/2026' (orientamento.unina.it). ADMISSION: 'Per essere ammessi al CdS Magistrale in Industrial Bioengineering occorre essere in possesso del titolo di Laurea appartenente alla classe L-8 o L-9 ai sensi del D.M. 270/04, rispettando i requisiti minimi curriculari specificati nel regolamento didattico del CdS, o altro titolo acquisito all'estero e riconosciuto idoneo.' (Regolamento Art. 4 / ordinamento 'Conoscenze richieste per l'accesso'). 'La verifica della personale preparazione e obbligatoria in ogni caso, e possono accedervi solo gli studenti in possesso dei requisiti curriculari.' (Regolamento Art. 5.2). 'Sono esonerati da tale verifica gli studenti per i quali la media delle votazioni (in trentesimi) conseguite negli esami di profitto per il conseguimento del titolo di Laurea che da accesso al CdS - pesate sulla base delle relative consistenze in CFU - sia non inferiore a 24.' (Regolamento Art. 5). '... valutera con giudizio insindacabile l'ammissibilita della richiesta, stabilendo gli eventuali adempimenti da parte dell'interessato ai fini dell'ammissione al Corso.' (Regolamento Art. 5). 'In termini del tutto generali, possono essere ammessi studenti laureati in Ingegneria Biomedica, Ingegneria Chimica ed Ingegneria dei Materiali che abbiano conseguito una valutazione CGPA non inferiore a 8.00/10.00 (min pass 6.00/10.00). La Commissione si avvale della facolta di intervistare il/la candidato/a in casi specifici per valutare la personale preparazione.' (Regolamento Art. 5). 'students with a degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering or Biomedical Engineering (L-9) at the University of Naples Federico II automatically satisfy the curricular requirements.' (DICMaPI SignUP). 'Students must have a CGPA of at least 8.00/10.00 (min pass 6.00) and a suitable English certificate.' (DICMaPI SignUP). ENGLISH: 'Per l'accesso al corso si richiede inoltre la documentata capacita di utilizzare correttamente, in forma scritta e orale, la lingua inglese, almeno pari al livello B2 (CEFR), secondo i criteri definiti nel regolamento didattico.' (ordinamento / Regolamento Art. 4). 'E inoltre necessario il possesso di una certificazione di conoscenza della lingua inglese di livello non inferiore a B2 (secondo la scala definita dal CEFR o valutazioni equivalenti).' (Regolamento Art. 5). 'If you choose a three-year, five-year or single-cycle degree course in ENGLISH, level B2 Italian language proficiency is not required.' (international.unina.it). DEADLINES: 'Dal 16 luglio e fino al 2 novembre, attraverso il servizio di segreteria studenti on-line "Segrepass", e possibile iscriversi al primo anno di un corso ad accesso libero' and 'Anche quest'anno e possibile procedere all'immatricolazione a partire dal 16 luglio e fino al 2 novembre 2026.' (unina.it, news dated 08/07/26). 'Gli studenti stranieri per immatricolarsi devono invece contattare via mail le segreterie studenti.' (same). 'JUNE - 15 - 2026 - Pre-enrolment application deadline to University of Naples Federico II. After this date no programme changes are permitted. After this date pre-enrolment is allowed to the programmes with restricted access only.' (international.unina.it). 'NOVEMBER - 30 - 2026 - Deadline for submitting the Visa Application at Iyalian Embassies /Consulates.' (international.unina.it, sic). 'Registrations and enrollments for years following the first usually take place in the period 1st September - 31st December of each year.' (orientamento.unina.it). FEES: 'Per gli studenti comunitari il contributo per l'iscrizione e di 200 EUR/anno + 140 EUR/anno di tasse regionali e marca da bollo di 16 EUR' and 'Gli studenti extracomunitari sono esentati dal pagamento dell'iscrizione ma devono pagare 140 EUR/anno di tasse regionali' (DICMaPI Iscriversi). 'EU students EUR 200/year (university fees) + EUR 140/year regional tax (compulsory) + EUR 16.00 legal stamp (compulsory) | Non EU students EUR 140/year regional tax (compulsory) + EUR 16.00 legal stamp (compulsory)' (unina.it course sheet). 'Il contributo per l'iscrizione viene determinato in funzione del reddito (ISEE Universitario) e della carriera (numero di cfu conseguiti e anno di iscrizione) di ciascuno studente.' (DICMaPI Iscriversi). VISA/FINANCIAL: 'EUR 10.179,85' per year subsistence and 'EUR 6.079,45 per year' for the residence permit (international.unina.it). STRUCTURE: 'La durata legale del Corso di Studio e di 2 anni. Lo studente dovra acquisire 120 CFU' and '... con il superamento degli esami, in numero non superiore a 12 ivi compreso l'esame finale' (Regolamento Art. 9). 'In generale, la frequenza alle lezioni frontali e fortemente consigliata ma non obbligatoria.' (Regolamento Art. 10). 'Massimo numero di crediti riconoscibili 24 - max 24 CFU, da DM 931 del 4 luglio 2024' (ordinamento). CAMPUS: 'Timetable lessons are held in the building of via Nuova Agnano.' and 'Directions Department of Chemical, Materials, and Production Engineering ... Piazzale Tecchio 80, 80125 Napoli' (orientamento.unina.it). PROGRAMME CONTENT: 'The study plan features a foundational core covering biology, biomedical data analysis, microfluidics, nanomedicine and tissue engineering. Students can then personalize their learning through two specialized tracks' (orientamento.unina.it) - the tracks being 'Data Driven Design and Modeling in Theranostics' and 'Design and Technologies for Biomedical Devices'. 'Access to the Master's Degree Course is subject to verification of possession of curricular and personal culture requirements. In particular, students with a degree in class L-8 (Information Engineering) or L-9 (Industrial engineering) may enroll in the Course. Students must also have obtained the degree with an average grade higher than 24/30 and must have a knowledge of the English language at least at level B2 (CEFR).' (orientamento.unina.it). uncertainty_notes: 1) CAMPUS - STREET NUMBER MISSING. The teaching venue is stated only as 'the building of via Nuova Agnano' with no street number on any official page consulted; international.unina.it likewise lists the bare label 'VIA NUOVA AGNANO'. The Piazzale V. Tecchio 80 address that appears in the orientamento 'Directions' block and in the DICMaPI footer is the DEPARTMENT seat, not necessarily where classes are held. Applicants should confirm the room/building via the EasyAcademy timetable. The outline entry listed campus as 'to be verified'; it is now verified to city and site level (Naples, Via Nuova Agnano complex, western Naples) but not to street number. 2) DEGREE CLASS NOTATION. Current governing documents say 'LM-21 R'; the orientamento profile and AlmaLaurea say 'LM-21'. Same class, different notation vintage; the outline's 'LM-21' is correct but incomplete. 3) ELIGIBLE FOREIGN DEGREE FIELDS - THREE-WAY DISCREPANCY. The teaching regulation (authoritative) names Biomedical, Chemical and Materials Engineering. The Italian admission webpage names FIVE fields, adding 'Ingegneria Meccanica ed Ingegneria Elettronica' (Mechanical and Electronic Engineering). The English version of the SAME webpage names only three. A Mechanical or Electronic Engineering graduate should therefore not assume eligibility from the Italian page alone and must ask the Coordinator. 4) THE ADMISSION PAGE'S SCOPE STATEMENT CONTRADICTS ITSELF ACROSS LANGUAGES. The English SignUP page opens 'The Course is open to students who have obtained a first level degree (Class L-8 or L-9) IN ITALY'; the Italian page opens 'Possono accedere al Corso studenti che hanno conseguito la Laurea di primo livello in Italia O ALL'ESTERO' (in Italy OR ABROAD). Both then go on to describe the foreign-degree route, so the English phrasing is a translation defect, not a policy restriction. 5) PRE-ACCEPTANCE LETTER - DIRECT CONFLICT. The programme states 'In the event of a positive outcome and upon request, students may receive a pre-acceptance letter to support their student visa application.' international.unina.it states the opposite at university level: 'Important! The University of Naples Federico II does not issue admission letters for obtaining a visa.' These can perhaps be reconciled (a departmental pre-acceptance letter is not a formal university admission letter), but a visa applicant should not rely on the departmental letter satisfying a consulate. 6) NON-EU TUITION EXEMPTION - PLAUSIBLE BUT WORTH RE-CHECKING. Three unina.it sources agree non-EU students pay only the EUR 140 regional tax + EUR 16 stamp. However, the same pages also state that the contribution is ISEE- and career-based, and the fee guide the programme links is the 2023-24 edition (Guida_Studente_rapida_23-24.pdf) while the university's own guides page currently offers only the 2024/25 edition - no 2026/27 guide was found. Confirm the current year's amounts with the calculator at calcolatrice.unina.it before budgeting. Note the exemption is described as applying to the enrolment contribution only; the regional ADISURC tax and stamp are not waived. 7) THE unina.it COURSE SHEET IS STALE. Page /-/12778359 still presents the pre-2025 curriculum (Biomechanics; System analysis for Bioengineering; Systems and Synthetic Biology; Biomedical Imaging and Computer Interface for Biological Systems; Robotics for Bioengineering; Mechanics in Tissues and Growth). The CURRENT 2025/2026 plan on orientamento.unina.it is different: common core of Biochemistry + Cell and Molecular Biology, Design of Biomedical Devices, Analysis and Simulation of Structures in Biomechanics, Bioinformatics and Data Analysis, Microfluidics for Lab-on-Chip, Tissue Engineering and Organ-on-Chip Technologies, Nanomedicine, plus two tracks, 15 ECTS electives, 3 ECTS other activities and a 15 ECTS thesis. There is also a second legacy asset id, 12930561, for the same course. Use the orientamento page and the 2025/2026 study plan PDF, not the unina.it sheet. 8) SEATS AND NON-EU QUOTA UNVERIFIED. No numbers are published; the corsi.unina.it/DD3 catalogue sheet - the page that carries SUA-CdS fields such as 'Locations' and access data for other Federico II courses - is an Angular single-page application whose backing API was not reachable server-side, so its structured fields could not be read. A browser session would be needed to confirm there is no sustainable-enrolment figure. 9) ENGLISH PLACEMENT TEST DATES ARE HISTORICAL. Industrial Bioengineering is confirmed as one of the Collegio di Ingegneria master's programmes covered by the CLA English placement test, but the calendars retrievable are from 2021 (DICEA, 4-12 May 2021) and 2023 (18 April 2023, CLA, via Mezzocannone 8). Current dates are published periodically at www.cla.unina.it. Also note the test is administered to ENROLLED first-year students as a curricular check, so its relationship to the pre-admission B2 certificate requirement is a sequencing nuance rather than a substitute for candidates who need documentary proof at application time. 10) NO EU-SIDE ACADEMIC DEADLINE. The only published EU date is the university-wide enrolment window (16 July - 2 November 2026); the prior step of having a foreign qualification assessed by the Coordinator has no published cut-off, which is a real planning risk for EU applicants with non-Italian degrees. 11) THE FOREIGN-APPLICANT ONLINE FORM IS NOT REACHABLE. The SignUP page's instruction to 'fill out the online form' is rendered as styled text without a working hyperlink, so the form URL could not be captured; bioenginering@unina.it (spelled with one 'e' in 'enginering' on the site, alongside 'bioengineering@unina.it' used elsewhere) is the fallback contact and both spellings appear on official pages. 12) SECOND-SEMESTER ENTRY NOT ADDRESSED. Unlike some Federico II master's programmes, nothing in this regulation provides for or excludes a second-semester intake; treat as unavailable unless the Coordinator confirms otherwise. 13) ACADEMIC-YEAR MIXING. Curriculum and regulation data are 2025/2026; deadline and fee-window data are 2026/2027. A 2026/2027 study plan had not been published at the time of research.
